title: Social Media Has A Field Day After Gunna Look A Like Is Spotted Work At Crocs' Store [Watch]
htmlContent:
Last week, a TikTok viral video had the public thinking that Gunna was working at a Crocs shop after allegedly ratting out Young Thug.

Earlier this month fans on social media started making fun of Gunna after a TikTok video of a person who looks like a rapper named YSL who works at a Crocs store.

In the video, posted by user @Stoneyy34 last month features a salesperson, who looks like Gunna works remotely behind the counter at the Crocs store.

"Gunna working at crocs after snitching [astonished face emoji]," the user captioned the video with Gunna's hit single "Pushin' P"  featuring Young Thug playing in the background.

The video went viral with almost 600,000 views across TikTok. On Twitter, fans joke about Gunna being an employee of the Crocs store after he reportedly flipped on Thug.

In the Hollywood Unlocked Instagram comment section. Grammy Nominated artist, NaiBoi wrote, "No way he pushin C. ."

While J CRUZ from The J Cruz show added, laughing emojis .

Speaking of Gunna, according to TMZ Hip Hop, Uzi, Thug, Gunna, the producer of Wheezy, as well as the record labels Atlantic and Generation Now. are being sued by Sun City Publishing for allegedly stealing samples from the 1995 Blackout song, "Dim Da Lights."

Per TMZ, the sample was used for the single "Strawberry Peels," featuring Lil Uzi Vert, Young Thug and Gunna.
